pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 80 degrees, relative humidity 36 percent, barometer 29.80 inches,
adjusted altitude 2,334 feet, track temperature 112 degrees.

The last time Matt Hagan went to four Final rounds in a row was in 2022 (Phoenix, Gainesville, Las
Vegas 4-Wide and Houston). He has never been to four consecutive Final rounds at "traditional races."

This is the 16th time in Funny Car history that the No. 7 and No. 8 qualifiers have met in the Final
round.
Paul Lee's 16 losses to Hagan are the most for him against any opponent.

Hagan is 16 - 2 against Lee in prior events and this is the first time they have faced each other in
a final round.

Lee with the starting line advantage and then got real loose.  The car made a move toward the wall,
he never hit the wall, but did cross the outer boundary line. 

Hagan kept it hooked up and hitting on all eight for the win.  He wins his fourth Wally this season
and 59th of his career.
